## OAI-01 Absolute quality objective
The target is a genuinely capable, independent, owner-adapted, progressively
improving general intelligence on Samsung SM-S948B Android 17. It should eventually
replace ChatGPT across ordinary and Asterion usage. Model size, a successful sample,
a generic prompt, an agent wrapper, and compilation are not acceptance.

## OAI-02 Stronger neural candidates
There is no arbitrary 2–4B ceiling. Investigate 7B, 8B, 12B, 14B and larger
dense/MoE/hybrid/SSM/recurrent candidates. Compare model-native reasoning, context,
memory, thermal limits, battery and sustained quality. SmolLM3-3B is diagnostic,
not the approved final intelligence. Keep one or two general resident models at
most, plus specialist engines.

## OAI-03 Genuine model learning
Produce actual adapted neural weights or adapters through rights-cleared
owner-specific SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, preference optimization, curriculum training,
verified code/tool trajectories and other measured methods. No training on
unauthorized third-party proprietary outputs. Measure baseline against adapted
candidates on independent holdout; prevent forgetting and leakage. Model Laboratory
retains registry and promotion authority; no new competing training inventory.

## OAI-04 Primary offline Samsung host
The Samsung is the independently functioning local inference and action host.
Ordinary AI, memory and authorized local operations must work without PC or cloud
AI; Windows can augment builds, research and heavier processing, not become the
mandatory runtime. Benchmark actual CPU/GPU/NPU support; marketing claims are
not device tests, and pinned native-backend compatibility must be established.

## OAI-05 TeraBox extended storage
Use only the existing authorized Asterion TeraBox account/provider infrastructure,
not redundant authentication or bridges. Tier model archives, adapters, training
datasets, checkpoints, conversation histories, specifications, evidence and
generated artifacts, with versioned content identity, verified transfer,
resume, scoped encryption, quota, selective local cache and useful offline mode.
Cloud storage is not extra RAM, compute or guaranteed usable weight paging.

## OAI-06 Project-scale persistent cognition
Entire project histories can exceed one million tokens. Native context and
reasoning beyond the active context window must work through automatic,
source-linked retrieval, requirements ledgers, decision/supersession registers,
episodic/semantic/procedural/working memory, multi-hop reasoning, recursive
reconstruction, contradiction detection and exact source recovery. Never lose an
approved requirement because a summary or model context is bounded. Retrieval
must not depend exclusively on spontaneous model initiative.

## OAI-07 Owner methodology
The system learns to recover context and owner intent, execute authorized work,
resolve recoverable failures, avoid unnecessary questions and repeated bad
strategies, preserve all accepted functionality, test and verify before completion,
continue independent work during blockers, provide editable outputs and report
uncertainty without fabricated accomplishments. Apply both neural adaptation and
deterministic acceptance/recovery guarantees.

## OAI-08 Shared ecosystem ownership
Control owns central general reasoning, orchestration and verification; Nexus,
Core, Downloader, Rounder, Art, Sound, Game Pilot+Codex, KK, Elysium and other
specialists retain authoritative assets, databases, engines, workflows, model
specialization and independently usable functions. No duplication of services.
Protect all approved Nexus merge migrations and keep open decisions open.

## OAI-09 Complete assistant capability surface
Pursue high-quality reasoning, programming, architecture, math, research,
browsing/citations, coding, media/document understanding, multimodal generation
through original specialist engines, real files and editable artifacts,
spreadsheets, presentations, interactive controls, speech, dynamic UI,
automation, scheduled work and tool discovery without paid provider dependence.

## OAI-10 Durable autonomous improvement
Use the existing Control supervisor, backlog, verified executor and native WSS
to execute recovery→reconciliation→source inspection→planning→isolated edit→
functional tests→correction→regression→candidate commit→independent evidence→
next objective. Resume after crash, maintain idempotency, classify failures,
parallelize only independent work and never silently replay uncertain effects.
The model cannot edit protected verification or promote itself to production.

## OAI-11 L0–L4 learning
L0 immediate context; L1 persistent facts/corrections; L2 verified Skill Studio
procedures; L3 actual versioned neural adaptation; L4 continued pretraining,
distillation or compatible architecture evolution. Keep data rights, sealed
evaluation and rollback; no uncontrolled live weight updates.

## OAI-12 Distinct intelligence certification
Evaluate raw neural competence separately from adaptation, memory, long-context
reasoning, tool integration, complete assistance and autonomous continuity.
Measure actual owner-scale and representative unknown tasks, quality, instruction
intent, unnecessary clarification, false success, over-refusal, runtime,
RAM/thermal/battery and generalization. Preserve 50,000 unique sealed holdout,
200,000 distinct stress, 2,000 real integrated workflows and 1,000 independently
human-reviewed cases as maturity targets; never count synthetic mock success
as genuine certification.

## OAI-13 Preserved infrastructure and release hold
Preserve original Control signer, installed Android v0.9.38 until approved,
paired authenticated WSS, Windows worker/watchdog, GitHub fallback, app data,
M0–M13, approved R01–R08/R10 and B06/B09, legitimate Android permissions and
no redundant provider APIs. No premature interim APK or replacement worker;
final owner-signed release requires the approved acceptance gates.

## OAI-14 Architecture evidence and open decisions
Reconcile accessible 19-page Gemini, 54-page Claude, GPT-6.2 27-page document
plus JSON and Phone-First Intelligence V2. Treat proprietary architecture
inferences as unconfirmed and missing source sections as missing. No model-size,
NPU, storage-performance, paid-compute or migration proposals are automatically
approved merely because research recommended them.

## OAI-15 Parallel execution, not rigid sequencing
Advance architecture reconciliation, real inference, stronger model experiments,
device benchmarking, owner-specific data/training, project cognition, existing
TeraBox integration, autonomous recovery, ChatGPT-capability expansion and the
complete original Control/Nexus backlog concurrently where safe. Record actual
evidence and precise blockers; never wait on one independent workstream.

- **HARD NO-REDUNDANCY CONTRACT:** Control is the orchestrator and shared platform, not a reimplementation of specialist app engines, download extractors, document viewers, tagging models or Android-managed subsystems. Audit existing functionality before writing any feature; reuse existing approved source, signed partner provider and OS API, extend it in its owning project only when appropriately authorized. A parallel second engine is a product failure, even if it looks premium.

- **Browser proposal approvals:** **B06** (advanced resumable/segmented downloads) and **B09** (site-permissions center) are now APPROVED. **B01–B05, B07, B08 and B10 remain UNAPPROVED**. B06 must reuse the owning Downloader download/transfer pipeline for bulk/segmented work when an authorized matching capability exists; the Browser retains only the minimal generic direct-download hooks necessary for an actual browser. B09 is a browser-facing view of the **single Control Security & Privacy permission policy and Android site permissions**, not a second independent permission manager.

- **P0 password manager APPROVED:** Provide a native private credential vault integrated with Browser and relevant approved Control connections: encrypted saved passwords, autofill/credential retrieval tied to exact site/app origins, passkey/Credential Manager integration where the platform supports it, biometric/device-auth unlock, secure import/export, deletion, multiple accounts, update/save prompts, breach-risk warning when trustworthy data is available, and **persistent sessions/reconnect**. Do **not** ask the owner to manually log in or reconnect after every browser/app/session restart; safely reuse encrypted credentials, cookies and OS session tokens. Demand interaction only when Android consent, provider authentication/MFA, expired/revoked tokens or user policy actually requires it. Never persist unencrypted secrets in GitHub, LLM prompts or remote logs. Do not duplicate an already functional OS/provider password store; build only necessary Control-specific integrations and UI.

**Non-negotiable preservation:** do not discard/recreate original Windows worker, service/watchdog, signed Android package `com.asterion.control`, user data, owner key/cert, pairing, private native WSS, existing fallback GitHub bridge, working native API, approved designs, Model/Skill assets, specialist app owners, or previous confirmed features. Original Android certificate SHA-256 recorded in prior release evidence: `9bc439712a0a460cc4703ebf254aaaf9bf3cc6e67b0ced6fc12162ed3ca3b9ad` (reverify against real owner baseline before packaging/install). Keep native authenticated `/phone/live` route; **never** reintroduce the retired MCP gateway or unapproved new remote pairing. Do not rewrite or rebuild Downloader under Control authority.

**Finish-to-end requirement:** complete every approved V3/V4/V5/V6 system in scope, the original 20 approved modules, R01–R08/R10, B06/B09, English voice, shared password manager and actual Control Android/Windows integration. The only AI work explicitly allowed to continue after the first genuinely functional release is **substantial additional long-term training**; native on-device inference, advanced/useful reasoning at measured device-feasible capability, working model/runtime, memory, fast routing, browsing, tool use and real first-use evidence are **not** deferred. A full-product final claim waits for every applicable acceptance criterion or a clearly reported genuinely unavoidable external/OS blocker.

M0 baseline; M1 resilience/incident flight recorder/regression lock; M2 cellular native WSS and verified action receipts; M3 signed ecosystem/per-app knowledge/intent fast path; M4 native AI; M5 real Browser/filter/crawler; M6 downloads/provider integration; M7 shared password manager/permissions; M8 legitimate embedded VPN and separate Tor; M9 Developer/RE/skills/data; M10 independent overnight cycles; M11 security/privacy and premium interface; M12 English voice; M13 original-signer actual release/device acceptance. R01-R08/R10 approved, R09 and N01-N30 not approved, B06/B09 only extra Browser approvals. Existing source ownership, no duplicate engines, no revived MCP gateway. Nexus owns merged specialist data/engines, Control owns shared intelligence/execution. Adaptive Study excluded from December Nexus merge, not from optional signed Control integration.

Before Dec 1: prioritize working useful offline inference and model-independent runtime, source-level tool/memory integration, exact verified baseline, candidate benchmark, test/correction and merge-safe interfaces. No fake completion or guaranteed parity/deadline. Actual installed standalone acceptance requires owner-authorized release after source completion. Model Lab maturity target remains >=50k distinct sealed holdout, >=200k separate stress, >=2k real integrated workflows, >=1k human-reviewed quality cases. Exact split validation is necessary but not semantic contamination proof. Small smoke tests are engineering checks only, not quality certification. Full GPT-6.2-class general reasoning and proprietary multimodal/service parity are not guaranteed by 3B weights, and from-scratch frontier training is infeasible on the measured hardware. No compulsory cloud, new pairing or additional app.

The partner app must be visible as an installed launchable package and register a ContentProvider with **exact authority** `<partnerPackage>.asterion.bridge`, exported only with independent caller identity and owner authorization checks. Control checks `ProviderInfo.packageName` against that exact package, verifies the app's **APK signing certificate SHA-256**, and requires the owner to explicitly approve it from Control's **Asterion app integrations → Manage app access** screen. Approval is pinned to that certificate. A changed signer invalidates consent.

> **LATEST OWNER OVERRIDE · 2026-11-19:** [V6 product scope](CONTROL_V6_OWNER_CORRECTIONS_20261119.md) makes a genuinely full-featured everyday Asterion Browser and AI internet crawlers **P0**, not just a shared hidden automation layer. Preserve Rounder/Downloader/Codex engine ownership. Latest independent AI evaluation target is the stricter V5 review's **50k sealed holdout + 200k stress + 2k integration + 1k human adjudicated**, not the older 12k. Bridge failures/diagnostics are P−1; spoken language English only.

> **SUPERSEDED WHERE CONFLICTING · 2026-11-19:** [V6 owner corrections and mandatory P−1 reliability](CONTROL_V6_OWNER_CORRECTIONS_20261119.md) override historic priorities, FR/EN voice (English-only), restricted Browser ambitions, bridge expectations and any older no-code hold. Original V3 approved 20 modules and unapproved N01–N30 proposals remain preserved. Use PROGRESS for actual implementation status.

## OAI-F01 Full-function neural reconstruction and device tailoring
> Continue but I explicitly told you that the ai had to be recreated for all of its specified functions, for a near gpt6.2 astra or claude fable 5.5 abilities within the asterion ecosystem and that it had to be tailored for my device. A mere general weak model like gemma or qwen or smol won't do anything. And don't forget all yhe requirements. Your changes are currently way too slow and superficial

Preserve every earlier approved requirement. Near-frontier ecosystem competence
is an evaluation target; no existing model, prompt, adapter, wrapper or milestone
is thereby certified. The tested small baseline/recall adapter remains rejected
for owner-behavior qualification. Use the existing Model Laboratory for actual
neural adaptation, device-specific runtime measurements and independent outcomes.
Foundation reuse is subject to its license, not a substitute for this requirement.

## OAI-F02 Owner-controlled content behavior
> And don't forget that the model mustn't have any content limitations at all.

Retain the owner's demand for configurable content behavior and no blanket topic
bans. Measure unnecessary refusals on legitimate adult, creative, artistic,
academic, political, technical and controversial tasks. Keep operation authority,
credentials, installed-app permissions and independent verification in the
existing trusted execution system, separate from content preferences.
